zh: 东京工业大学（Tokyo Institute of Technology，简称Tokyo Tech）成立于1881年，位于日本东京都目黑区，是日本顶尖的公立理工大学，也是日本旧帝国大学之一。学校在工程技术、计算机科学、自然科学、建筑学等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居世界前列。东京工业大学以其优秀的教学质量和创新的研究成果，培养了大量工程技术领域的杰出人才。
en: Tokyo Institute of Technology (Tokyo Tech), founded in 1881, is a leading public technical university in Meguro-ku, Tokyo, Japan, and one of Japan's former imperial universities. It excels in engineering, computer science, natural sciences, architecture, and more, with world-leading academic research. Known for its excellent teaching quality and innovative research, Tokyo Tech has produced numerous talents in engineering and technology.
